segments.speaker: townsfolk_farmhand
segments.text: The watch says the goblins scattered when their old woman fell. Scattered where, in this cold?

segments.speaker: townsfolk_farmhand
segments.text: Carried my first sack up the goblin path today. The little ones watched me the whole way.

segments.speaker: townsfolk_farmhand
segments.text: Ground under the docks went cold as a grave. Nobody's saying why.

segments.speaker: townsfolk_farmhand
segments.text: Hands are cold, but they still work. That's something.
